title: Design the target way of working for product
summary: Describe how product teams should be set up and work together: who owns what, how decisions are made and how teams relate to each other.

beginner: Describe how product teams are set up today.
List the problems this causes, from your interviews.
Sketch a target setup that fixes the biggest problems.
Check it with a few leaders and PMs.
Write it up in plain language.
intermediate: Decide whether teams are given problems to solve or features to build.
Define team types and how they work with each other.
Plan the move from today's setup in steps.
experienced: Design the operating model across product, engineering and design.
Align funding and planning with the new team setup.
Agree the leadership roles the model needs.

canDelegateTo.task: Agree the target model and its funding
Advise on team boundaries and architecture

toolExamples.miro: Draw today's and the target team setup side by side.
toolExamples.confluence: Publish the target model with the reasons.

pitfalls: Changing structure without changing how decisions are made
